description: Land Acquisition - Pelenwatta, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific parcels of land being acquired for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of locations, boundaries, extents, and neighboring properties. The content is exclusively focused on land matters without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other administrative matters that would fall under other categories.
